subject.title: fix(codex): fail-closed on unknown item statuses and warn on dropped notifications

question: Should the Codex projector intentionally fail closed on explicit unknown app-server item statuses, knowing future or custom Codex binaries may see those statuses projected as failures until OpenClaw maps them?
rationale: Repository policy treats fail-closed runtime behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and code review cannot choose the permanent unknown-status contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept fail-closed after proof
options.body: Land this PR or a sibling branch after the warning-scope issue is fixed and real runtime or standalone harness proof is added.

options.title: Define a softer unknown outcome
options.body: Pause this branch and create an explicit non-success unknown projection contract instead of mapping unknown explicit statuses to failed.

options.title: Choose a different candidate branch
options.body: Keep this PR paused while maintainers repair or select another overlapping PR for the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed after proof
recommendation.body: Land this PR or a sibling branch after the warning-scope issue is fixed and real runtime or standalone harness proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history in the Codex turn-routing and projector boundary where this compatibility choice sits.
